title: Amazon Echo Auto 1st Gen Hands-Free Alexa - Never Used, Sealed
categoryName: Consumer Electronics:Surveillance & Smart Home Electronics:Smart Speakers, Hubs & Accessories:Smart Speakers
descriptionText:
Experience the convenience of hands-free voice search with the Amazon Echo Auto. This smart speaker is compatible with both Android and Apple devices, and comes with a variety of features such as Bluetooth connectivity and a clip-on design. The rectangular shape and black color make it a sleek addition to any home decor.

With a RMS power of 5W, this device is perfect for those who want a powerful yet compact speaker. The audio inputs include USB, and it comes with a power adapter, microUSB cable, vent mount, and aux cable for easy setup. This smart speaker is also compatible with Alexa, making it the perfect addition to any smart home.
